mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_runs (id, workspace_id, knowledge_base_id, goal, agent_key, agent_version, prompt_id, prompt_version, model_provider, model_name, configuration, deadline_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{goal}, #{agentKey}, #{agentVersion}, #{promptId}, #{promptVersion}, #{modelProvider}, #{modelName}, CAST(#{configuration} AS jsonb), #{deadlineAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_runs SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{runId} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND deadline_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))

UPDATE agent_runs SET lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE agent_runs SET cancel_requested_at = COALESCE(cancel_requested_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{runId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_APPROVAL')

UPDATE agent_runs SET status = #{next}, final_answer = #{answer}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{runId} AND status = #{expected} AND (#{owner} IS NULL OR (lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AND (#{next} != 'COMPLETED' OR cancel_requested_at IS NULL)
mapper.select: UPDATE agent_runs SET next_step_sequence = next_step_sequence + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL RETURNING next_step_sequence - 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_steps (id, workspace_id, run_id, sequence_number, type, status, input_summary) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{runId}, #{sequence}, #{type}, 'RUNNING', CAST(#{summary} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_steps SET status = #{status}, output_summary = CAST(#{summary} AS jsonb), error_code = #{errorCode}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{stepId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tool_executions (id, workspace_id, run_id, step_id, tool_call_id, tool_name, tool_version, idempotency_key, status, arguments_hash, arguments_redacted) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{runId}, #{stepId}, #{toolCallId}, #{toolName}, #{toolVersion}, #{idempotencyKey}, 'RUNNING', #{argumentsHash}, CAST(#{argumentsRedacted} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_executions SET status = #{status}, observation_summary = CAST(#{observation} AS jsonb), error_code = #{errorCode}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{executionId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
